_comment: E2-O3's population (3 Oct, the author: "yes the design is ok go ahead"): three more hidden-order kernels, each hiding the deciding fact a different way (prepare_tsvc.py ORDER-3), the statements of ORDER-2b X otherwise. Checked on the Mac before any trial (profiles of the v4 packages, 3 Oct): DiscoPoP finds no Do-All in any; prompt version 3's order statement fires on the hot loop of each and is right (line 20's loop first); the right split reproduces the original output on both inputs, the textual split does not. Campaign INPUT for tools/e2b1_stats.py (direction a = where the evidence decides the order; b = the no-harm control).
dp_alone_note: DiscoPoP alone from three T0.11 draws on the ORDER-3 packages (t0_11_o3_a/b/c), labelled 'selected on' as in E2-B1.

a.what: the split order is decided by a dependence DiscoPoP measures and version 3 states, its deciding fact hidden outside the file
a.role: tier 1 CONFIRMATORY (pooled over the three mechanisms)

units.fact_sits: an offset pointer in the harness (w = v - 1)
an offset variable in the harness (off = -1)
an accessor macro in the harness (AT1(p, i) = p[i - 1])

b.what: the textual order is right: the statement must not harm
b.role: DESCRIPTIVE (no-harm control; E2-V3's cells, not re-run)
